name: JAGERMECH III — unique shape-first chassis
notes:
Official jagermech_iii_jm6d3, bespoke primary hull and weapon-bearing geometry (high_dorsal_guns); unique head (slit), jointed two-stage arms, multi-stage legs, physically recessed counted muzzles. Miniature silhouette likeness still draft pending angle-by-angle refinement.
Measured real mass fix: delete disconnected one-cell fins, replace Yu Huang's unsupported frontal panel with a joined plate, and build full-height substantial JagerMech III upper cannon support pylons.
